---
description: next-intl usage, key naming and the both-locales rule
applyTo: "messages/**,src/**/*.tsx,src/i18n/**"
---

# i18n (next-intl 4.14)

Config: `src/i18n/routing.ts` (`locales: ["en","ro"]`, `defaultLocale: "en"`,
`localePrefix: "as-needed"` → `/` is EN, `/ro/...` is RO), `src/i18n/request.ts`
(reads the locale via `next/root-params`, no `setRequestLocale`),
`src/proxy.ts` (next-intl middleware), `src/i18n/navigation.ts`
(`Link`, `redirect`, `usePathname`, `useRouter`, `getPathname`).

## Usage

- Server components / metadata: `const t = await getTranslations({ locale, namespace: "projects" })`
  or `getTranslations("projects")` inside the request scope.
- Client components: `const t = useTranslations("projects")`.
- Current locale: `getLocale()` (server) / `useLocale()` (client). Never read
  `params.locale` deep in the tree — pass it or use these.
- Links: **always** `Link` from `@/i18n/navigation` (locale-aware), never
  `next/link`. Same for `redirect`/`useRouter`.
- Registry text (`tagline`, `summary`, `story`) is `LocalizedText { en, ro }` in
  `src/data/projects.ts`; select with `text[locale]`.
- Formatting: `useFormatter()` / `getFormatter()` for dates & numbers — no
  hand-rolled `toLocaleDateString`.

## ICU plurals — Romanian has a `few` category

RO: `one` (1), `few` (2–19, and 0 with `=0`), `other` (≥ 20, needs "de").

```json
"results": "{count, plural, =0 {Niciun proiect} one {# proiect} few {# proiecte} other {# de proiecte}}"
```

EN only needs `one`/`other`. Always include `=0` when zero has its own wording.

## Key naming

- Namespace = page or component: `meta`, `nav`, `theme`, `locale`, `hero`,
  `now`, `featured`, `projects`, `openSource`, `timeline`, `contact`, `about`,
  `uses`, `press`, `footer`, `common`, `notFound`.
- camelCase leaves; nest by UI block (`projects.filters.status`).
- No dynamic key construction except over a known enum (`t(\`status.${status}\`)`).
- New pages add `nav.<key>` (Header/Footer), `meta` title/description keys.

## Both-locales rule

Every key exists in **both** `messages/en.json` and `messages/ro.json` with the
same path and the same ICU argument names. `scripts/check-messages.mjs` (run by
husky pre-commit and `pnpm ci:local`) fails on missing/extra keys. Add it to the
same commit as the component using it. Diacritics in RO are mandatory (ș ț ă î â).
